correction_03.trigger: B main independently exported the real-engine meshes and reviewed them (evidence assets-main-review-03) and rejected correction-02 on two findings.

findings.B-ASSETS-CONTAIN05: the casing visual CylinderMesh at nominal radius 0.4 m encoded 384 face vertices outside the disabled CylinderShape3D radius 0.4 m envelope; worst signed excess 5.470416716468751e-05 m at (0.153099998831749, -0.369600176811218, 4.0)
findings.B-ASSETS-HAND06: all 18 cutter studs used the column set (tangential, surface_normal, along) with determinant -1; every transformed face orientation was flipped and the clockwise volume was -1.824e-06 m3

fixes.casing_encoded_visual_radius: 0.3998 m (CASING_VISUAL_RADIUS_M, 0.0002 m inside the nominal 0.4 m). Engine snapping to the 1e-4 m CylinderMesh grid can add at most sqrt(2)*5e-5 m radially, bounding every encoded vertex at <= 0.39987071 m; measured real-engine max_radius_about_z_m 0.39983182371023 m, margin 1.6817628977e-04 m inside the disabled collision radius 0.4 m. The nominal 0.8 m diameter / 8 m length stay declared-envelope values; the collision keeps radius 0.4 m / length 8 m.
fixes.stud_frame: the stud basis uses z = -along (determinant +1) with the same cylinder axis (mesh-local +Y -> surface_normal) and the same symmetric encoded vertex cloud; measured 18 of 18 studs det = 1.0 and positive clockwise transformed volumes (min +1.824e-06 m3)

correction_03.new_transformed_face_checks: tests/test_asset_contract.gd verifies on the actual transformed mesh faces: every asset triangle is inside at least one disabled convex shape (box/cylinder/capsule, shape-local coordinates, 2e-6 m slack); every visual part has det>0; every closed individual mesh has directed paired edges and a nonzero positive clockwise volume after transform (overlapping parts allowed; no union watertightness claim); an intentionally enlarged casing and a mirrored stud must fail the containment / handedness checks; the 30-instance probe is exact (70 meshes, 43904 triangles)
correction_03.private_selfcheck: the private scratch export self-check mirroring the B-main review math reports zero findings; B main reruns its own independent export and review

provenance_rules.all_assets: original procedural geometry authored by the B asset domain in this repository; no downloaded models, textures, scans or third-party installers; license see simulator/assets/LICENSES.md
provenance_rules.bounds: declared envelope is the closed-form design bound; measured AABB values below come from the independent double-precision Python replica of the exact generator formulas (replica script recorded in evidence); the runtime factory re-measures actual transformed mesh vertices and stores geometry_bounds_m and pivot_bound_radius_m as metadata on every instance; measured_engine_20261016 blocks hold real engine values from the 2026-10-16 MEASURE lines and supersede replica values where they differ; correction-03: the casing visual solid encodes at radius 0.3998 m (measured AABB 0.7996 m) inside the nominal 0.8 m declared envelope - the declared envelope is the design bound, never a claim that the encoded visual mesh has exactly the nominal diameter
provenance_rules.volumes: mesh volume computed by the divergence theorem over the same triangles; star-mesh volumes are replica values for the exact deterministic vertex formulas; fault is a closed-form box prism volume; casing now quotes the real-engine value at the correction-03 encoded visual radius 0.3998 m; volume_m3 quotes the real-engine value measured 2026-10-16 under the explicit Godot clockwise front-face convention (-sum(p0.dot(p1.cross(p2)))/6 over the stored triangle order, positive for an outward closed solid)
provenance_rules.front_face_winding: Godot ArrayMesh front faces are clockwise: the custom star meshes in world/obstacle_geometry.gd are index-wound clockwise with outward vertex normals (correction-02 fixed the previous counter-clockwise order); BoxMesh and CylinderMesh primitives already encode clockwise front faces; the contract test asserts per-face outward orientation, no mixed winding and an opposite-winding negative control; correction-03 asserts the same explicit clockwise convention on the transformed faces of every individual visual part (det>0, directed paired edges, positive volume) with an enlarged-casing containment control and a mirrored-stud negative control
